news.title: New Scotland boss calls-up just 14 World Cup players as Oli McBurnie returns
news.lede: The Hull City striker was controversially left out of Steve Clarke's World Cup squad despite helping fire the Tigers to promotion. His omission came despite scoring 17 Championship goals as well as the winner in the play-off final last term. He has since featured in all four of Hull's Premier League outings this season. McBurnie, who has featured 17 times at senior international level, could now win his first cap since appearing against the Faroe Islands in March 2021.

news.title: 2030 World Cup: Morocco still insists on the final
news.lede: Spain’s victory in the final of the 2026 World Cup at the expense of Argentina (1-0, ap) officially opened the way for the 24th edition of the World Cup, co-organized by Spain, Morocco and Portugal, with three matches played in Latin America to celebrate the centenary of the competition. While Spain and Morocco are already arguing behind the scenes over the organization of the final, Fouzi Lekjaa, president of the Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF), continues to demand this final meeting. A few days after affirming that the final of the next World Cup would take place in Casablanca, before being taken over by Fifa, the Moroccan leader was at it again. Also Minister Delegate for the Budget, Fouzi Lekjaa spoke in an interview given to Young AfricaMonday, while he is in the middle of the campaign before the Moroccan legislative elections on September 23.

news.title: Munich and Barcelona to host UEFA Champions League finals
news.lede: Adjustments made to 2026/27 UEFA Nations League play-off system. The UEFA Executive Committee met today in Thessaloniki, Greece and appointed the hosts of several finals as follows:. New promotion/relegation system for UEFA Nations League 2026/27. The UEFA Executive Committee approved adjustments to the promotion/relegation system of the 2026/27 UEFA Nations League, to allow for a smooth transition to the new concept that was approved in May 2026, whereby the UEFA Nations League will consist of three leagues instead of four leagues as of the 2028/29 edition.

news.title: World Cup 2030 : Morocco takes another dig at Spain
news.lede: Morocco has once again made its ambitions clear regarding the 2030 World Cup final, which Spain, Portugal and Morocco will co-host. Moroccan federation president Fouzi Lekjaa previously claimed that the Benslimane province would host the showpiece match, prompting FIFA to deny that it had already selected a venue. Lekjaa has now addressed the issue again in an interview with Jeune Afrique, insisting that Morocco will defend its right to stage the final. “It might be hotly contested by the Spanish.

news.title: FIFPro, UEFA Demand Independent Review of FIFA FFE Plan
news.lede: Fifpro and Fifpro Europe backed UEFA’s call for an independent review of FIFA’s scrapped Forward Enterprise plan, which sought private investment in World Cup commercial operations. A $20 billion valuation assigned to FIFA’s Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal has intensified scrutiny over the governing body’s decision-making process, prompting Fifpro and Fifpro Europe to formally support an independent review on Monday. Under the FFE scheme, private investors would have acquired a 20 per cent stake in a business entity responsible for managing commercial operations across FIFA events — including both the men’s and women’s World Cups. The project was abandoned after three continental confederations rejected it, with UEFA threatening to boycott FIFA tournaments unless the plan was withdrawn and assurances given against any future recurrence.

news.title: Christian Tsangas named in Pararoos squad for IFCPF Men’s World Cup 2026
news.lede: Football Australia has confirmed the 14-player CommBank Pararoos squad that will represent Australia at the IFCPF Men’s World Cup 2026 in Atlanta, USA from 12-24 October. Head Coach Kai Lammert’s squad features significant World Cup experience, with 11 players returning from the group that represented Australia at the 2024 edition in Salou, Spain. The squad also includes first-time Pararoo Josh De Silva (Football West), whose journey back to football following an acquired brain injury has culminated in his maiden national team selection. The squad features players from five Member Federations across Australia, with five representatives from Football NSW, four from Football West, three from Football Victoria, and one each from Football Queensland and Capital Football.

news.title: Three new names in first All Whites squad after World Cup
news.lede: Three players could earn their first All Whites caps after being called up to the first squad since the Fifa World Cup. Darren Bazeley’s latest squad will face Palestine, China, Panama, and one of Ecuador or Japan over September and October, with captain Chris Wood leading the line-up alongside World Cup goalscorers Finn Surman and Elijah Just. Goalkeeper Henry Gray, currently on loan at the Wellington Phoenix from Ipswich Town, and Kilmarnock’s George Stanger could be in line to pick up their first caps having been called up to Bazeley’s squad before, while Stipe Ukich has been promoted from the Under-20s to potentially make his debut for the first team. Bazeley feels the squad can build on the foundations laid at the World Cup while giving new faces a chance to establish themselves.
